asked.item: Why the post went out at a different time than the scheduledTime sent
How to schedule for New York time

verdict.reason: The Timezone page says a timestamp without an offset is treated as UTC, and it explains how to send the time with an offset.

steps.text: A timestamp without an offset is treated as UTC, and the scheduledTime you sent had no offset or Z.
Resolve your timezone for the intended date, then send scheduledTime as ISO-8601 with an explicit offset or Z.
Account for daylight-saving changes when you resolve the offset.
